== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Kashyyyk (Dark) (Japanese)|Kashyyyk]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=67773 Japanese A New Hope source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(28, 12, 469, 625)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>2a95c234d859b902a290a3f1e978ffe754333466b7c76e7ef6846b622af29283</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
